acceptance.given: A replay result has otherwise-valid status while a result-determining input has drifted without an explanation.

oracle.expected: Replay validation or use marks the result stale or fails closed without accepting it as current.

acceptance.then: The affected replay result is stale or the operation closes without accepting it.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Detect unexplained result-determining input drift during replay validation or use, then mark the replay result stale or fail closed without accepting it as current.
